run_generate_waveform_cli: run the generate_waveform CLI to synthesize audio waveforms from discrete codes and F0 contours using a CodeHiFiGAN vocoder
run_main_waveform_generation: run the main function to load a vocoder, process input data, and generate waveform audio files
create_dump_result_wav: create a function that writes a predicted waveform tensor to a WAV file using soundfile
create_load_data_from_file: create a function that loads and parses line-delimited data from an input file using ast.literal_eval
create_get_f0_upsample_ratio: create a function that computes the F0 upsampling ratio from code hop size and F0 hop size
